And—and the land of…The king of—of Moab was perhaps a little afraid of his father, because Ahab had a mighty army. And Israel united pretty good during the time of his reign. So he’d sent over several thousand sheep, because the king of Moab was a sheep master. And many of the…He’d sent these sheep kinda of a—to keep peace between the two nations. But then, perhaps after his son reigned in his place, well, he desired then, to perhaps come and take them back again. So he knew that his son wasn’t the warrior that his father was.
